create_TransformerEncoderLayer: create a transformer encoder layer with self-attention, cross-attention, and configurable pre-norm or post-norm architecture
build_TransformerEncoder: build a transformer encoder that stacks multiple encoder layers to process multi-level features with optional activation checkpointing
build_TransformerEncoderFusion: build a transformer encoder that fuses text and image features with optional torch.compile for performance
test_pool_text_feat: test the pool_text_feat function that mean-pools prompt embeddings with optional mask-aware pooling
refactor_TransformerEncoderLayer_forward: refactor the TransformerEncoderLayer forward method to support divide-and-conquer attention on half the queries
